description: Remove an attachment from a pitch and from the document store. Requires editing rights, enforced server-side. This feature owns the read-only-user assertion for the whole resource: by the time it lands both mutating endpoints exist, so one test module can prove a viewer is refused on upload and on delete together, rather than each endpoint asserting half of it. If the store deletion fails, the record stays — a row whose file is gone is recoverable, a file with no row is invisible.
expectedBehavior: A viewer is refused on delete and on upload, by the server, on a direct request
An editor's delete removes both the record and the stored file
A failed store deletion leaves the record in place and reports the failure
Deleting an attachment does not affect other attachments on the same pitch
verificationSteps: Call the upload and delete endpoints directly with a viewer's credentials and confirm both are refused with the same status; call the list endpoint with the same credentials and confirm it succeeds
